conventions.angular_counting: one representative 2-component radial channel per kappa; full vacuum multiplier 4*kappa still gives zero; packet excites one mode
conventions.energy_split: h_A={P_A,H}/2, h_B=H-h_A; half interaction energy per region
conventions.local_energy_caution: regional Dirac energy is not a probability and can be negative even in a positive-energy state
conventions.metric: static smooth compact axial S1, a=1,R=2,N=q=1
conventions.operator: existing node/edge H_kappa, no added scalar field or free link
conventions.packet: positive-energy projection of C-infinity bump centered -0.6, width 0.35, momentum 4, +sigma2 spinor; AP topology
conventions.packet_origin: prepared excitation, not created by a computed collapse or vacuum process
conventions.region: x>=0, with throat and compact seam cuts; lattice cut approaches x=0 as h->0
conventions.units: hbar=c=a_throat=1; energies scale as 1/a, integrated transfer as 1/a, rates as 1/a^2

exact_identities.equilibrium: [H,C]=0 implies Tr(C J_A)=0 for every fixed regional energy split
exact_identities.finite_system_time_average: (E_A(T)-E_A(0))/T -> 0 for fixed finite H and state; no uniform infinite-volume/time limit asserted
exact_identities.plateau_requirement: Q/(H rho_b)=1-2 q_dec at a constant f<1; acceleration requires Q/(H rho_b)>1
exact_identities.present_value_control: if f=0.95,q_dec=-0.55 were already a plateau, epsilon_required=0.105, Q/(H rho_b)=2.1; these are benchmark inputs, not predictions
exact_identities.state_memory: eliminating B yields retarded memory AND B exp(-i H_BB t) psi_B(0); its covariance and initial cross-correlations are separate data

unresolved: absolute renormalized stress on varying throat
physical parent/child state or in-state and causal continuation
coarse-graining to proper-volume cosmological Q and H
